assessment_objectives.objective: roles and responsibilities exist to compel data and/or process owners to collect, consider, prioritize and integrate risk-related feedback, per an organization-defined frequency, from those external to the team that developed or deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

Individual Contributor (IC) performance reviews cover how data and/or process owners collected, considered, prioritized and integrated risk-related feedback on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) per an organization-defined frequency.
